name: Oaks & hickories
desc: Dominant trees of the drier forest. Their acorns and nuts are the fall mast that bears, turkeys, deer and squirrels fatten on.
about: An oak is a hardwood tree or shrub in the genus Quercus of the beech family. They have spirally arranged leaves, often with lobed edges, and a nut called an acorn, borne within a cup.
